summary: Fortress Credit Realty Income Trust filed an 8-K reporting an unregistered sale of 644,560 common shares for ~$12.9M gross proceeds at net asset value per share, exempt under Section 4(a)(2), Regulation D/S. It also declared routine monthly distributions across multiple share classes. This is a standard private placement and distribution declaration, not a special situation. No strategic transaction, activist, or restructuring is involved. The filing is purely operational and capital-raising.
